Test local Doppler-assisted Bun commands, the Alchemy configuration path, GitHub workflow behaviour through deterministic tests or safe hosted proof where authorised, missing/malformed configuration, secret-negative logs and receipts, preview/production isolation, and documented recovery. Run focused checks after each slice and the full repository verification at closeout. Update the SPEC, task ledger, active/completed execution plans, canonical architecture, operations docs and runbooks in the same slices. Commit coherent work, open and merge the required pull request to main when checks pass, then confirm exact origin/main identity and hosted check results.

Repository implementation and pull-request/merge work are approved by this request. Do not publish packages, change DNS/domains, deploy unrelated resources, expose secrets, or create/rotate/revoke Doppler, GitHub or Cloudflare credentials without the explicit operation-specific authority required by docs/operations/authority-model.md. Finish only when the reviewed SPEC is implemented as far as current authority allows, all remaining exceptions are named and bounded, and the task provides a plain-English summary of what changed, what was proved, what remains, and what was deliberately not claimed.</input>
